what: Headless-sim diagnosis of the owner's 2026-11-15 report: Wicks on RIFT leave the lane line and come back near the 2nd (inner) tower, mostly on the top lane
runs: 24 runs on HEAD 62f2d49e8 + 24 on 098ac7436 (pre ruling 39): seeds 3,7,11,19,23,31 x {idle fighters, computer-played fighters} x {towers alive, all outer towers killed at 2:30-4:30 (one side) / +60 s (other side)}, 0:00-14:00, every tick, every Wick
conventions: d = signed lateral offset from the lane polyline (the lane's waypoint path); +d = left of team-0 travel; 'down' = world +y = screen DOWN under the fixed-yaw default camera (screen up = -y). FREE = no attack order, no chase flag, no swing/windup/anim, no cast, no attackable enemy within aggro range; the first and last 6 m of each road are left out

files.trail_top_team0: _design/reviews/orch1/wobble_sim_trail_high_t0.svg (seed 3 idle, team 0 free Wicks 0:00-5:30, x 18..56 y 10..34: trails sit below the dashed waypoint line between waypoints and turn before each waypoint dot)

verdict: The dip is corner cutting of the lane polyline by every free Wick on every wave, not a stall, a nav detour or ruling 39. units/minions.ts followLane advances to the next lane waypoint once the Wick is within WAYPOINT_REACH = 2.5 m of the current one and then attack-moves in a straight line to it; with the line of walk clear (no nav path, no body lane for Wicks) movement.ts stepToward walks that chord. The road polylines of the top and bottom lanes bend most (12-20 deg per waypoint) between the base lantern and the inner tower, so the chord leaves the line by 0.4-0.7 m on the INSIDE of each bend and converges back on the next waypoint (a sawtooth: dip right after each waypoint, back on the line at the next). The top road arcs toward -y, so its inside is +y = screen DOWN ('under the path'); the bottom road is the mirror (inside = screen UP). The wave's side columns (spawned 1.1 m either side) then press on the middle one as all three converge on the same waypoint, and separation (movement.ts separate, factor 0.5) pushes the outer-side Wicks further out, to 1.0-1.3 m. Larger 2-3.3 m swings near the inner towers are Wicks walking back after a fight (they fought standing 2-3 m off the road; followLane walks straight to the next waypoint ahead, so they rejoin over 6-9 m).
